title: LLM Interprets Each Post, Stay Duration Increases Dramatically - Meta Bets on AI Recommendations Sparks New Controversy

content_html:
At Meta's Q2 2026 earnings call, it was disclosed that Instagram's user session length saw double-digit growth year-over-year, driven by an upgraded AI recommendation system. CEO Mark Zuckerberg and CFO Susan Li stated that generative AI has become a core technology for improving content distribution efficiency and user engagement, and the company will further expand this recommendation framework to Facebook's main feed in the future.

According to the report, Meta has used large language models (LLMs) to perform semantic analysis on all public posts in Reels and Feed, identifying content themes, semantics, and potential emotions. Combined with the Muse model, which focuses on video classification and summarization, the system gains a deeper understanding of content. The system then generates more accurate personalized recommendations in real time, relying not only on traditional behavioral signals like clicks and likes but also on users' historical interaction data.

The largest Reels sorting algorithm upgrade so far has already yielded significant results, increasing total session volume by 15 basis points and significantly boosting video sharing rates and viewing duration. The company believes that more accurate AI recommendations can not only enhance user experience but also help creators reach a broader audience and increase ad display opportunities.

However, AI-driven recommendation strategies continue to face regulatory pressure. Meta is currently facing lawsuits from over 20 states in the U.S., alleging that its platform design may lead to youth addiction. The company disclosed that legal expenses related to these lawsuits have reached $2.4 billion, and several cases involving youth protection are expected to go to trial later this year. As generative AI becomes deeply integrated into social media recommendation systems, how to balance enhanced personalization, business growth, and user well-being has become a key focus of ongoing industry attention.

content_html_zh:
在 Meta 的 2026 年第二季度财报电话会议上，据透露，在升级的人工智能推荐系统的推动下，Instagram 的用户会话时长同比实现了两位数增长。 CEO马克·扎克伯格和CFO苏珊·李表示，生成式AI已经成为提高内容分发效率和用户参与度的核心技术，未来公司将进一步将这一推荐框架扩展到Facebook的主要Feed中。

报告称，Meta 使用大型语言模型（LLM）对 Reels 和 Feed 中的所有公开帖子进行语义分析，识别内容主题、语义和潜在情绪。 结合专注于视频分类和摘要的Muse模型，系统可以更深入地理解内容。 然后，系统不仅依赖点击和点赞等传统行为信号，还依赖用户的历史交互数据，实时生成更准确的个性化推荐。

迄今为止最大规模的Reels排序算法升级已经取得了显着成果，将总会话量增加了15个基点，并显着提高了视频共享率和观看时长。 该公司认为，更准确的人工智能推荐不仅可以增强用户体验，还可以帮助创作者接触更广泛的受众并增加广告展示机会。

然而，人工智能驱动的推荐策略继续面临监管压力。 Meta目前面临美国20多个州的诉讼，指控其平台设计可能导致青少年沉迷。 该公司透露，与这些诉讼相关的法律费用已达24亿美元，多起涉及青少年保护的案件预计将在今年晚些时候开庭审理。 随着生成式人工智能深度融入社交媒体推荐系统，如何平衡增强的个性化、业务增长和用户福祉已成为行业持续关注的焦点。
